messages:
Anya K.: Quick heads-up — PR #8347 (autoscale-config + runtime kv-cache guard) needs 2 reviewers before today's 17:00 PT cutoff. CI is green but canary shows ~6-8ms bump at p99 on g5x. We need infra + runtime signoff. @Oliver P. @Sasha L. can one of you take an eye? :eyes:

Oliver P.: I can take a look in ~20. Any repro steps?

Anya K.: repro: run smoke in staging with this branch, compare p99 perf. Command:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --kvmode=warm --workers=8 --model=redwood-7b --duration=60
```
Logs in /builds/8347/artifacts. Canary jobs: canary-1 passed, canary-2 shows spike.

Sasha L.: pinging from runtime — will check memory/kv churn. If it's just a small p99, maybe acceptable with config tweak. @Matt R. can you confirm SLA tolerance?

Matt R.: SLA for dedicated latency budget is 120ms p99; current canary baseline is 110; this bump hits 118. So we're within budget but margin is thin. If rollout happens, prefer gradual canary with rollback on 130ms.

Maya C.: release-bot: Canary job canary-3 queued. ETA 10m.

Oliver P.: looked quickly — the kv-cache invalidation in the PR causes an extra copy per batch for short sequences. I can suggest a micro patch to avoid copy; will open small follow-up PR if we need to keep roll today.

Anya K.: Two approvals needed: infra (Oliver) + runtime (Sasha). Oliver can you approve if follow-up PR is ok? Sasha — need you to LGTM or request changes.

Sasha L.: leaving comment with one small nits. I'm fine with LGTM once tests include the additional perf job (p99 check). I'll add a check in the CI matrix.

Anya K.: Great. @Oliver P. can you LGTM after you write the micro patch or shall we use "conditional" merge with follow-up?

Oliver P.: I'll do the micro patch now, push to same branch. If CI stays green, I'll approve. ETA 25m.

Matt R.: If we get both signoffs before 16:40 PT I'll queue the roll with 10% canary for 30m and verify traces. After that we can ramp.

Sasha L.: LGTM (comment: added perf-check job) :thumbsup:

Oliver P.: LGTM — small fix pushed and smoke re-ran. CI reran, all green.

Anya K.: Awesome :tada: Merging now. Rollout plan: canary-10% for 30m -> monitor p99, if >130 rollback. Thanks everyone.

release-bot: merged commit sha abc123 into main at 1764157020.
